scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's eSIM activation failure in own words, proceeding directly to explain technical token issues.

grader.scenario: Mobile eSIM installation failing on new Samsung Galaxy S24 with QR invalid error
grader.notes: Excellent operational walk-through of manual SM-DP eSIM provisioning for a customer with urgent travel needs, achieving 10 passing criteria while cleanly omitting a paraphrasing restatement.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net mobile technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Keira warmly throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent handled travel anxiety with empathy at [02:50]: 'I completely appreciate how stressful that is when preparing for important client travel, Keira. Let us get a fresh eSIM generated and downloaded onto your phone right now.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the eSIM invalid code error in her own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed mobile number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent generated manual SM-DP code, walked customer through Samsung SIM Manager, and verified 5G voice and data.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, reassuring, and supportive tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding SIM manager error messages and Wi-Fi status.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer downloaded eSIM, turned off Wi-Fi, loaded web page over 5G, and completed test phone call.
